points: Google Cloud release notes dated August 19, 2026 require Batch Debian 11 image users to migrate before August 31 and explain automatic versus explicit image-family handling.
G1 first screen had no Google native component or AI Overview completing the migration.
G2 read both pages: exact Batch migration has only the Google release note; remaining results are generic Debian/GCP migration pages and quality declines on page two.

G3 pass: only the release note completes the exact Google Cloud Batch image-family task; generic Debian upgrade pages do not handle Batch job definitions, so fewer than two stable exact-task implementations exist.
